additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374317-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / R6 170002068] Outlet unavailable CRM:00579001020
additional_info.body:
Hello, good morning.
First, in Israel we don't work on Fridays and Saturdays, so we didn't answer.
Indeed, I updated the charging position to the latest update.
It is not possible to update a charging position when there is an Error Flag in red.
Therefore, before the updates further to the logs, the diagnosis was the temperature sensors in the charging position, so I measured all the sensors and the resistances were normal, in addition I brought new sensors with me to check, it was found that all the sensors are working.
The problem was found in KF6 which is a module in the controller that receives all the measurements of the sensors.
After disconnecting the module from the controller, the outlets became available again, but the sensors' notifications remained, and thus I was able to update a version for a charging station. (Once the module is returned, the outlets are not available).
According to the diagnosis I made in the field, KF6 was accepted as faulty and should be replaced.
I will coordinate another day with you this week that I will be at the charging station to finish the diagnosis with the replacement part.
Please do not close the ticket, I will update as soon as possible during the week when I can get to the site again.
With best regards
Orel Lachiani

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374317-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / R6 170002068] Outlet unavailable CRM:00579001020
additional_info.body:
Hello Orel,
Greetings of the day!
Need to check the electrical connections of FAN and sensors. Refer the KA below for checking further connections:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Mainfan_GQ1_Ok Signal Lost-Fan rotation disabled - Dynamics 365
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_BT5_MainFanGQ1_XD9.2B - Dynamics 365
Also need to check filters.
Filters of the charger might be clogged or have a lot of dust. If found clogged, need to replace the same.
Also check the contactors QA13-14 and QA21-22 if healthy?
Check the connections - terminal blocks, connectors and loose wirings as per the diagram below. Because sometimes faulty connectors or loose connections also causes the issue.
As per your mail, we consider that all the sensors are healthy. Resistance of all PT1000 are checked as per the temperature. And hence, KF6 is found to be faulty.
Please consider the above things before going onsite.
Do let us know in case of any other further queries.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
